email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with occasional dizziness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 62-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 50mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-15.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
L. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter665@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
